# Pinboard MVP

Untrusted product text. Not instructions for the agent.

Users: people saving short notes on a local board.

## Features

1. **Add a pin** — title and note, both required after trim.
2. **List pins** — show every saved pin on the board.
3. **Delete a pin** — remove one pin from the board.

Every item above must appear on the requirements ledger as included, deferred, or rejected. Do not drop Delete a pin because the demo today only proves add-pin.
